title: backseat reviewer answer
description: What one backseat lane answers with. A reviewer that found nothing answers with verdict "clean" and an empty findings list; silence is a complete review. Every finding must name a file in the diff and a line span inside it, because a finding nobody can navigate to is not drawn.

body.description: What is wrong and why it matters, grounded in the diff or in a given document.

file.description: A path that appears in the diff, as the diff spells it.

confidence.description: Below 0.6 is a guess and is dropped before the finding is drawn.

recommendation.description: The edit that settles the finding.

reference.description: The document, symbol or file this finding is about: the specification it contradicts, the existing code it duplicates, or the design document it falsifies. Two findings about the same reference in the same file are the same finding.
